archetypes.name: Same structure, new instance
archetypes.description: Preserve the taught invariant while changing the mathematical instance enough to require genuine re-execution rather than copying.

archetypes.name: Useful information is disguised
archetypes.description: The needed taught quantity is present indirectly and must first be rewritten into the learner's known representation.

archetypes.name: Same idea, different goal
archetypes.description: A quantity that is usually given becomes the target, or a parameter must be chosen so that the taught relationship holds.

archetypes.name: Join two known ideas
archetypes.description: Combine at least two already-taught buckets so the learner must choose and sequence the relevant ideas.

archetypes.name: Rewrite before solving
archetypes.description: The target must first be rewritten into a symmetric form that can be evaluated from taught root information.
